# External Agents / Skills / MCP

This directory holds third-party agents, skills, and MCP servers that the
curator skill has approved for vendoring.

Sub-directories:
- `agents/`  — external agent .md files
- `skills/`  — external SKILL.md files
- `mcp/`     — MCP server config stubs

Entries are added ONLY via the `/curate` command after explicit approval.
Do not add files here manually.
